card.line: Sitnah was a well Isaac's servants dug in the valley of Gerar. Its name means strife, because people quarreled over it.

moments.title: A second well, a second fight
moments.text: Isaac's servants dug another well, and the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled over this one too. So Isaac named it Sitnah. After this he moved on and dug another well, and no one quarreled over it.
